heading.title: Of Mortgages of Immoveable Property and Charges

article.title: Rights of mesne mortgagee.
article.content: Where a property is mortgaged for successive debts to successive mortgagees, a mesne mortgagee has the same rights against mortgagees posterior to himself as he has against the mortgagor.]
article.html:
94Rights of mesne mortgagee.

Section 94 · Chapter IV · Redemption · page 36 of the Act

Where a property is mortgaged for successive debts to successive mortgagees, a mesne mortgagee has the same rights against mortgagees posterior to himself as he has against the mortgagor.]
